definitions.gloss: clerical work; office job; desk work
definitions.explanation: A job category involving administrative, clerical, or desk-based tasks such as data entry, filing, scheduling, and general office administration.

examples.japanese: {事務職|じむしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧。
{事務職|じむしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have three years of experience in office work.

examples.japanese: {事務職|じむしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Office jobs are popular and attract many applicants.

notes:
USAGE:
A common job category used in job listings and career discussions. Contrasts with ⟦{営業職|えいぎょうしょく}→営業職：19232_eigyoushoku⟧ (sales position) and {技術職|ぎじゅつしょく} (technical position).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事務職|じむしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧ (to take an office job)
- {事務職|じむしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to prefer an office job)
- {事務職|じむしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧ (office job openings)
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧{事務職|じむしょく} (general clerical position)
